rv.q: It explores an interesting idea in an interesting way and it invites the audience to pause and reflect, which is no bad thing.
In Time is a poignant, contemplative piece that involves its audience in its personal thought process.

cn.t: Forced Entertainment's time-travel meditation earns praise for its contemplative, hypnotic exploration of ethics and possibility, with Tyrone Huggins delivering an engaging solo performance of speculative scenarios.
